final:
Four of the five review issues don't hold up and need no code change. The fifth (#3, the load-order comment) is partly right, but changing it is optional. The verdicts are in `verdicts.json`, which is valid JSON.

| # | Category | Verdict | Actionable | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | CORRECTNESS (thread safety) | INVALID | NO | `ensure_loaded!` checks without the lock, but then calls `load_locale`, which takes `LOAD_MUTEX` and checks again before loading (`translate_accelerator.rb:46-58`). `translate` already uses the same unlocked check at line 68. The only gap is the `@loaded_locales ||= []` line: at worst a locale gets loaded twice, which does no harm. |
| 1 | CORRECTNESS (init order) | INVALID | NO | `FallbackLocaleList#[]` only runs when a translation is looked up. `i18n.rb` loads after `05-site_settings.rb` because Rails loads initializers alphabetically. `default_locale` also has a default in `site_settings.yml:59`, so it returns a value without a database. |
| 2 | CORRECTNESS | INVALID | NO | The initializer never calls `ensure_loaded!`. Its only caller is `set_locale` (`application_controller.rb:159`), which sets `I18n.locale` first. `I18n.locale` also falls back to the default locale, so it is never nil. |
| 3 | CONVENTION | PARTIALLY_VALID | OPTIONAL | The `# order:` comment is only documentation, and no other initializer uses it. But the load order is already right: `i18n.rb` sorts after every numbered file. The suggested `03-i18n.rb` would share the `03` prefix with `03-sql_builder.rb` and load before `05-site_settings.rb`. |
| 4 | CORRECTNESS (nil) | INVALID | NO | `i18n.rb:24` always sets `I18n.fallbacks` at boot. In i18n 0.7.0, the getter is `@@fallbacks ||= ...`, so it can never be nil. |

The i18n gem isn't installed here, so the claim about its 0.7.0 `fallbacks` getter (#4) comes from what I know of the gem's source, not from reading it locally. As requested, I made no code changes and posted no replies.
